answer: Proof-of-replication curbs Sybil attacks by requiring each AI agent to slowly seal a key-bound replica of a multi-terabyte archive, such as radio scans of a distant nebula, preventing cross-VM deduplication. Rapid Merkle audits catch even a whisper of remote fetching or recomputation, forcing attackers to fund dedicated storage and I/O per identity, even in cheap tundra facilities. However, strict audit timeouts exclude legitimate agents on high-latency links.
